description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers auditing/inventorying current brand expression and flagging drift. Should-not covers near-miss neighbors.

baseline our current brand expression before the refresh
where does our copy drift from the brand voice

generate a new logo for us
audit just the UI components to find reuse opportunities
emit our brand tokens as CSS custom properties
validate this single banner asset against the token spec in CI
